steps.title: Given the user is on Actions Center > Target Sources of analysis A

Then the fr.trustpilot.com pages show as one article
And the fr-be.trustpilot.com pages show as another article
And no article is listed per page URL

results.notes: Data adapted (CNP Assurances is production-only, P6): Orange 16cdf040, trustpilot.com, Last 7 days (29 Oct - 4 Nov, 8 snapshots up to the forced crawl 04/11 11:42 UTC), AI Engines 2 (ChatGPT + Gemini), All Countries. Cards shown with tabs ALL / IMPROVE VISIBILITY / IMPROVE PERCEPTION. Panel header '#4 · trustpilot.com', chips 'Review Sites' + 'Improve perception', tab 'Negative perception (6)' active, subtitle 'Each of these articles mentions Orange negatively.' The fr.trustpilot.com pages of /review/www.orange.ma show as ONE article 'Avis de Orange Maroc' (URL line fr.trustpilot.com/review/www.orange.ma, chip '20 NEGATIVE REVIEWS') with page blocks https://fr.trustpilot.com/review/www.orange.ma and ...?page=4 (10 negative reviews each). The www.trustpilot.com pages show as ANOTHER article 'Orange Maroc Reviews' (URL line trustpilot.com/review/www.orange.ma, chip '30 NEGATIVE REVIEWS') with page blocks p1, ?page=2, ?page=4. fr-be.trustpilot.com/review/www.orange.ma is a third, one-page article. 6 article rows for 9 cited page URLs; tab count 6 = card 'Negative perception in 6 articles' (green frames on the two grouped articles). The only ?page=N URL shown as an article line is ie.trustpilot.com/review/www.orange.ma?page=2, the only ie page cited in this window (one article for the ie subdomain, classic passage) - in Last 30 days it is merged into the ie article. Observation: page block links show the full URL with https:// while article URL lines show it without the scheme (CSV examples show no scheme) - display detail, no AC. Known side finding (GEO-1547 rerun) visible here: ?page=4 / ?page=2 blocks start with the same entries as page 1; two reviews duplicated in www.trustpilot.com/review/www.orange.ma page 1.
